test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 05 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined words in the given sentence.

After the heavy rains last Thursday, the water in the river __raised another three feet__.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The verb "**raised**" is **transitive**, meaning it requires a direct object (e.g., "She raised her hand").
 
• In this sentence, the water level increases **by itself**, so the correct verb is the **intransitive** verb "**rose**", which does not take a direct object.
 
• The sentence is in the **past tense** ("after the heavy rains last Thursday"), so "**rose**" is the appropriate past tense of "rise."
 
• Other options are incorrect: 
 
 
• **Will raise** – future tense; incorrect for a past event.
 
• **Risen** – past participle; needs an auxiliary verb (e.g., "has risen").
 
• **Raise** – base form; tense does not match and is also transitive.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"After the heavy rains last Thursday, the water in the river **rose another three feet**."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rise (rose, risen)** – Intransitive verb (e.g., The sun rises in the east).
 
• **Raise (raised, raised)** – Transitive verb (e.g., They raised the flag).
